Fixed by adding the missing newline; re-verified chat renders and sends/receives cleanly post-fix with zero console errors.

rca_of_issue: Chat screen bug RCA: in app/chat/[id].tsx line 118 (pre-fix), the closing '>' of the header View's opening tag was immediately followed by literal spaces and then '<TouchableOpacity' on the SAME line with no newline in between (`}]}>        <TouchableOpacity ...`). JSX/Babel only strips whitespace-only text that spans a newline; same-line whitespace between two sibling-adjacent tags is preserved as a real text-node child. react-native-web's View component throws/logs an invariant violation ('Unexpected text node... cannot be a child of a View') for any non-empty text child that isn't wrapped in <Text>, which surfaced as a persistent red error banner and disrupted the chat screen's visual layout on every load. Mitigation applied: inserted a newline between the two JSX tags so Babel correctly strips the whitespace at compile time; verified via fresh Playwright run that the chat screen now renders cleanly with zero console errors and messages send/receive correctly.
